info.title: API.SH: FlightAware
info.description: The FlightAware API from API.SH: public FlightAware data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
An aircraft's registration record: year, make and model, category, seats and engines, owner (companies and organisations; private owners are withheld), owner type, airworthiness class and date, serial number, engine, weight, Mode S code (octal and hex), registration status, certificate, last action and expiry dates, and the registry source.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightaware-aircraft

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: N12114 (1995 BOEING 757-224 owned by UNITED AIRLINES INC) Aircraft Registration

get.summary: FlightAware airborne flights of an aircraft type
get.description:
Every airborne flight of one aircraft type (20 per page): flight number, operator, flight id, origin, destination, departure time and estimated arrival. Sort by any column. Pass `next_offset` back as `offset`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightaware-aircraft-type-flights

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One airport's boards as its public page shows them: the latest arrivals and departures and the next en route and scheduled flights (up to 20 each), each with flight number, operator, aircraft type, the other airport, and departure and arrival times (local), plus the airport's name, city and codes.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightaware-airport

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: ICAO or IATA airport code, e.g. `KSFO` or `SFO`.

get.summary: FlightAware airport details, runways and FBOs

An airport's overview: location and owner, coordinates and elevation, local time, tower, runways (length, width, surface, condition, lights), fuel types, FBOs with fuel prices and services, nearby FBOs with cheaper fuel, hotels and restaurants, maintenance, flight schools and other airport businesses, based aircraft counts and radio frequencies.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightaware-airport-details

get.description:
Airports currently reporting delays worldwide: airport, delay type (departure, arrival), average delay in minutes, trend and the full status text. The list is empty when no airport reports delays.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightaware-delays

get.description:
One flight as FlightAware shows it: status, airline, origin and destination airports with gates and terminals, scheduled, estimated and actual gate and runway times, taxi times, aircraft type and engines, altitude, speed, heading and position while airborne, distance flown and remaining, the filed route with planned speed, altitude and fuel burn, the inbound flight, photos, and the same flight number's recent and upcoming flights. `track=true` adds the full position track and route waypoints. Without a date the page's current or next flight is returned; a flight link or `flight_id` picks one leg.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightaware-flight

parameters.name: ident
parameters.description: Flight number (ICAO like `UAL1` or IATA like `UA1`) or an aircraft registration (`N12114`). Required unless `url` or `flight_id` is given.

parameters.name: flight_id
parameters.description: A FlightAware flight id from another answer (e.g. `UAL1-1793604984-airline-266p:0`).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A flightaware.com/live/flight/... link (including a dated history link).

parameters.name: track
parameters.description: true adds the position track and route waypoints.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The last 14 days and the next scheduled flights of a flight number or registration: date, aircraft type, origin and destination, departure and arrival times (local, with estimated marks), duration or status, filed route and the link to each leg (use it as `url` on /flightaware/v1/flight).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/flightaware-flight-history

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.note: the last 14 days and the next scheduled flights, as FlightAware shows them logged out; times are local to each airport

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
